newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki up, shrugs off forex drama, Nokia strong.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki up, shrugs off forex drama, Nokia strong.

text.p: Strength in telecoms group Nokia and food group Raisio helped Finnish shares higher on Monday despite the markka's sharp appreciation which caused confusion and depressed some exporter stocks, brokers said.

The general HEX index added 0.52 percent to 2,718.9 points but the development between various issues was trendless -- 49 advanced, 46 fell and 22 were unchanged. Volume was a healthy 570 million markka.

Some 50 percent of trade was in Nokia which remained bullish, ending up 8.10 markka at a new 315.00 year-high although some investors were starting to edge towards the sidelines ahead of its 1996 report due on February 13.
Raisio jumped 26 markka to a new all-time high of 405.00 on lively foreign buying partly sparked by reports of a maintained "buy" recommendation from CS First Boston.
Forestries and metal shares were hit by the markka's advances against the dollar, with the forestry sub-index down 0.4 percent and the metal index down 1.4 percent.
Underlying sentiment remained positive but brokers feared deteriorating earnings prospects for exporters if the markka continued to rise.
"If the markka's strengthening continues, it could turn stocks lower," said one.
Finland's largest bank Merita, which has advanced 19 percent in an almost straight line this year, fell 0.30 to 16.20 in a correction.
